name: Anvil
description: NSF ACCESS national resource operated by RCAC: 1,000 regular nodes (2x AMD EPYC 7763, 128 cores, 256 GB), 32 large-memory nodes (1 TB), 16 GPU nodes (4x A100 40GB) and 21 AI nodes (4x H100). Charged in ACCESS SUs: 1 SU = 1 core-hour; GPU queues charged at the ACCESS exchange rate (Anvil GPU 67.308 credits per GPU-hour, Anvil AI 133.342). USD rate is an estimate (shadow price).

name: Gilbreth
description: Purdue community GPU cluster (modernized Aug-Oct 2025): A10, A30, A100 40GB/80GB and H100 partitions plus a training partition for >2-GPU workflows. Labs buy per-GPU-type access; normal QOS up to 14 days, standby QOS up to 4 h and free. Units are A100-40GB-equivalent GPU-hours; USD rate is an internal estimate (RCAC prices are login-only).

name: Gautschi
description: Purdue flagship (2024): 338 CPU nodes (2x EPYC 9654, 192 cores), 6 highmem, 6 L40S nodes and 20 AI nodes with 8x H100 SXM 80GB (160 H100). AI partition uses a GPU-hour bank (1 GPU-year = 8,760 GPU-hours). Since 2026-11-02: normal max 4 days, preemptible 0.25x up to 30 days, burst 2x up to 8 h. Units are H100 GPU-hours (CPU core-hours convert at 0.005); USD rate is an estimate.

name: Negishi
description: Purdue community CPU cluster for tightly-coupled MPI (450 nodes, 2x EPYC 7763 Milan, 128 cores, 256 GB, HDR100) plus 5 AMD MI210 GPU nodes; retires 2028. Sold as half-node (64-core) shares. Units are core-hours; USD rate is an estimate.

name: Bell
description: Former Purdue community CPU cluster (2x EPYC 7662, 128 cores). Decommissioned 2026-10-31; scratch data unrecoverable after 2026-10-30 17:00. Successor: Gautschi. Historical jobs kept.

name: AWS p4d (us-east-1)
description: Third-party burst capacity: AWS ParallelCluster with p4d.24xlarge instances (8x A100 40GB, 96 vCPU, 1,152 GB). On-demand ~$32.77/instance-hour (~$4.10/GPU-hour); spot ~0.38x. Paid from lab cloud credits. Data leaves Purdue: export-controlled and human-subjects data not allowed.
